snippet.title: The Ultimate Battle Of The Sexes - Quiz & Play! (PlayStation3 & Wii Gold Edition)
snippet.description:
Following on from its huge success on the Wii, the battle of the sexes is set to cross over to another platform in the shape of „The Ultimate Battle Of The Sexes -- Quiz & Play!" for PlayStation®3 and Wii. By means of gripping contests like Car Parking and Multi-Tasking and a thrilling TV show, players can find the answer to the burning question: At the end of the day, which is really the weaker sex?

Features:
24 mini games with gender specific topics
10 unique avatars with new outfits
New TV Quiz Show mode with more than 500 questions
2 teams with maximum 10 players
Single gaming possible
Three different game modes

More infos: www.ultimate-battle.com
